scheme_name: HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth

text_blocks.text: HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Key fund facts): NAV (03-09-2026): ₹37.99740. Expense ratio: 0.22%. Minimum SIP investment: ₹100. Fund size (AUM): ₹4,893.86 Cr. Riskometer Category: Very High Risk.
HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Exit load): Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 15 days.
HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Benchmark): Fund benchmark: Domestic Price of Silver
HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Investment objective): The scheme is seek to capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Silver ETF (HSETF).

HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Stamp duty and tax): Stamp duty and tax implication: If you redeem within two years, returns are taxed as per your Income Tax slab. If you redeem after two years, returns are taxed at 12.5%.

HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth (Fund management): Fund Manager: Arun Agarwal. Education: Mr. Agarwal is a B.Com. and Chartered Accountant. Experience: Prior to joining HDFC Asset Management Company Limited, he has worked with SBI Funds Management Pvt. Ltd., ICICI Bank Limited, UTI Asset Management Pvt. Ltd.
